name: therapistools
description: Free browser tools for K-12 educators and school therapists: scheduler, IEP writer, worksheets, activity ideas.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/worksheets && npm ci --prefix apps/scheduler && npm ci --prefix apps/iep && npm ci --prefix apps/ideas
scripts.test: node scripts/check-caddy-routes.mjs && bash scripts/test-publish.sh && npm test --prefix apps/worksheets && npm test --prefix apps/scheduler && npm test --prefix apps/iep && npm test --prefix apps/ideas
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/worksheets && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && cd ../scheduler && npx tsc -b && cd ../iep && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../ideas && npx tsc --noEmit
